name: character-prompt
title_zh: 三视图定妆照，让角色从此不跑偏
tagline_zh: 画风漂移、五官乱飞？一张设定图锚住正面/侧面/背面，后续每次生成都认这同一张脸，不再每次开盲盒。
tagline_en: Tired of faces morphing between shots? Lock front/side/back views once, and every later generation stays true to.
desc_en: 角色最终提示词规范 — 风格化 3D 动画角色设定图 + 三视图（character turnaround：正面/90 度侧面/背面），作为后续所有生成的形象锚点
why_zh: 把角色规范写成最终提示词，不是临时描述——它把三视图当作后续所有生成的硬锚点，从源头掐断风格漂移。
why_en: It bakes the turnaround into a final prompt as a hard anchor for all future generations—killing style drift at the source, not.
limit_zh: 只认风格化 3D 动画角色，真人/写实/2D 纸片人无效；只出设定图与三视图，不负责表情页、动作页或场景。
limit_en: Only stylized 3D animated characters; no realistic/2D. Outputs turnaround sheets only—no expression sheets, poses, or scenes. Needs an existing.
title_en: Character turnaround sheets that lock your design
